cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1.0)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "/home/suhjw/gnss-sdr/cmake/Modules;/home/suhjw/gnss-sdr/cmake/Modules")
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE CXX)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
add_definitions([==[-Dhas_transform_reduce]==])
cmake_policy(SET CMP0065 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 NEW)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/home/suhjw/gnss-sdr/work/CMakeFiles/CMakeTmp")
add_executable(cmTC_3c01e "/home/suhjw/gnss-sdr/work/CMakeFiles/CMakeTmp/src.cxx")
set_property(TARGET cmTC_3c01e PROPERTY "CXX_STANDARD" "20")
set_property(TARGET cmTC_3c01e PROPERTY "CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED" "ON")
set_property(TARGET cmTC_3c01e PROPERTY "CXX_EXTENSIONS" "OFF")
target_link_libraries(cmTC_3c01e ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
